description: This file defines API route handlers for work order operations in a manufacturing maintenance backend, including listing, creating from alerts, updating, closing, and reserving parts for work orders. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and custom schemas.

methods.name: date|None _parse_due_date(due_at: str)
methods.description: Parses a due date string into a date object, accepting ISO date or datetime.

methods.name: list_work_orders(status: str | None = Query(default=None), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of work orders, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: create_from_alert(payload: WorkOrderFromAlertCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new work order from an alert and marks the alert as acknowledged.

methods.name: patch_work_order(workOrderId: str, patch: WorkOrderPatch, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing work order.

methods.name: close_work_order(workOrderId: str, payload: WorkOrderClose, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Closes a work order and resolves the linked alert if present.

methods.name: reserve_parts(payload: ReservePartsCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Reserves parts for a work order and updates inventory accordingly.

ctags.signature: (workOrderId: str, payload: WorkOrderClose, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
